copy.hook: Three events to circle in December 🗓️

facts:
Fetched 2026-11-25. federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar, 2026: "December 8-9*", footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic
Projections." bls.gov December 2026 release schedule (times Eastern): Employment Situation for November 2026, Friday December 4, 2026,
08:30 AM; Consumer Price Index for November 2026, Thursday December 10, 2026, 08:30 AM. The Consumer Price Index measures the change over
time in prices paid by consumers. The Employment Situation reports payroll jobs and the unemployment rate.

The publisher's records and SLE_CONTENT_LEDGER.md were read on 2026-11-25: this post was not published before. The owner asked for it to be prepared for the days before 2026-12-04.
slides_text:
IMAGE: Dates to know. Three events to circle in December.
Fri, Dec. 4, 8:30 a.m. ET: Jobs report. Payroll jobs and the unemployment rate for November, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
Tue and Wed, Dec. 8 to 9: Federal Reserve meeting. A two-day FOMC meeting, listed with a Summary of Economic Projections.
Thu, Dec. 10, 8:30 a.m. ET: Consumer prices (CPI). The Consumer Price Index for November: how prices paid by consumers changed. From the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
Save this post for December.
FOOTER: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics release schedule; Federal Reserve FOMC calendar. Checked Nov. 25; schedules can change. Educational content only. Not financial or investment advice.
